subject: histogram bin on orginal scale but plot with x axis scaled by log2?

messages.author: c21e804e07c5e732
messages.subject: histogram bin on orginal scale but plot with x axis scaled by log2?
parts:
Hi,

I thought that scale_x_log2 scales after the data has been binned. But
it seems that it scaled first and then binned (i.e., the binwidth is
at the scale after log2 transform of x).

qplot(x, data=data, geom='histogram', binwidth=1)+scale_x_log2()+scale_y_log2()

Is there a way to bin the data first and then log2 transform x?

--
Regards,
Peng

messages.author: dc06d729e023580a
messages.subject: Re: histogram bin on orginal scale but plot with x axis scaled by  log2?
parts:
Hi Peng,

You probably want coord_trans(x = "log2"). But a log scale on the
y-axis doesn't make any sense for a histogram because the bars start
at y=0.

Hadley
